description: Renders a FACET source, target NRQL query as a Sankey flow chart

configuration.name: accountId
configuration.title: Account ID
configuration.description: Account ID to be associated with the query

configuration.name: query
configuration.title: Query
configuration.description: NRQL query with two FACET attributes (source, then target) and one aggregate. Set LIMIT explicitly, e.g. FROM PageView SELECT count(*) FACET pageUrl, salesforceCustomerName LIMIT 25

configuration.name: labelContent
configuration.title: Node label content
configuration.description: Text shown under each node name. Add a prefix or suffix to values with constants in the query, e.g. '$' as 'prefix' or ' ms' as 'suffix'. Percent is the share of the total flow leaving the first-level nodes

configuration.name: sortOrder
configuration.title: Sort order
configuration.description: Source orders the first-level nodes by value and groups the rest under them. Target does the same from the last level. Alphabetical sorts every node by name. Default: Source, largest first

configuration.name: enableTimePicker
configuration.title: Enable Time Picker
configuration.description: Allows the use of the time picker

configuration.name: enableFilters
configuration.title: Enable dashboard filters
configuration.description: Allows the use of dashboard filters
